content: चण्डा, -ण्डी {%f.%} .²1 An epithet of Durgā. .²2 A passionate or angry woman; चण्डी चण्डं हन्तुमभ्युद्यता माम् <ls>M. 3. 20</ls>; चण्डी मामवधूय पादपतितं जातानुतापेव सा <ls>V. 4. 38</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 5</ls>; <ls>Me. 104</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of plant. .²4 A kind of perfume (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>वाळा</ns>). .{@-ण्डी@} .²1 A term of endearment applied to oneʼs mistress. .²2 Hurt, injury.
